name: Stereo Calibrate
summary: Calibrate an 8-bit stereo pair from checkerboard image folders paired by identical filename. Uses all accepted pairs in one batch; outputs K1/D1/K2/D2 and left-to-right R/T in meters.

rightDir.label: Right checkerboard images
rightDir.description: Pairs must have identical filenames in both folders; images must have equal resolution.

squareSizeM.label: Checkerboard square size (m)
squareSizeM.description: Physical square edge length. This determines the baseline and reconstructed distance scale.

minPairs.label: Minimum accepted pairs
minPairs.description: Use varied board tilts, positions, and distances. More pairs alone do not guarantee a reliable calibration.
